_documentation.purpose: Single source of truth for how the GLB Builder finds the Noble Architecture project portal, resolves a project code to its folder, names design phase folders, and drives the ProjectVision build + Cloudflare R2 push.
_documentation.projectCode: Two uppercase letters followed by two digits - AA00, RB05, EB03, NP03.
_documentation.folderNames: DesignPhases below is the CANONICAL naming set. 'aliases' lists older folder names that mean the same phase; the plugin recognises them and never renames a folder that already exists on disk.
_documentation.editing: Safe to hand-edit. Reloaded on every plugin load and on Reload Scripts.

PortalRoots._note: Searched in order, after any Portal Root saved on the model. The first path that contains a {NN}-Projects folder AND sits in a full repo clone (BuildPipeline.ScriptDirRel beside it) wins; a bare {NN}-Projects tree is used only when no clone is found. Each computer keeps the repo somewhere different, so list every one - a path missing on this computer is skipped. Override in the dialog's Project tab if the portal lives elsewhere.

MasterIndex._note: Relative to the repo root (the parent of the portal root). Written by ProjectVision__BuildScript__.py on every build.

DesignPhases.Label: Existing Conditions
DesignPhases.Description: The as-existing building. One model per project, never schemed.

DesignPhases.Label: Concept Design
DesignPhases.Description: Concept design options. One folder per scheme.

DesignPhases.Label: Planning Approval
DesignPhases.Description: The scheme submitted for planning approval.

DesignPhases.Label: Building Regulations
DesignPhases.Description: The scheme developed for building regulations approval.

BuildPipeline._note: Relative to the repo root. The plugin runs these two scripts directly, in this order - exactly what ProjectVision__BuildPipeline__.ps1 does for '--Project--{CODE}--TV' (its menu option 3). Running them directly skips the PowerShell layer and its trailing Read-Host prompt.

Python._note: Leave PythonExecutable empty to auto-discover. Set it to a full python.exe path if discovery picks the wrong interpreter. SketchUp's child-process PATH can resolve a bare 'python' to the Windows Store stub, which produces no output at all.
